title: कांग्रेसको नयाँ कार्यसमितिले आजदेखि जिम्मेवारी सम्हाल्ने, शपथ ग्रहण विगतभन्दा फरक हुने
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौँ । नेपाली कांग्रेसको १५औँ महाधिवेशनबाट निर्वाचित नयाँ केन्द्रीय कार्यसमितिले आजदेखि विधिवत् रूपमा पार्टी सञ्चालनको सम्पूर्ण जिम्मेवारी सम्हाल्ने भएको छ । ललितपुरको सानेपास्थित केन्द्रीय कार्यालय (बीपी स्मृति भवन)मा आज दिउँसो २ बजे आयोजना हुने विशेष समारोहमा नवनिर्वाचित पदाधिकारी तथा सदस्यहरूले शपथ ग्रहण गरेर जिम्मेवारी सम्हाल्न लागेका हुन् । केन्द्रीय निर्वाचन समितिका अनुसार आजको समारोहमा पार्टी सभापतिबाहेक बाँकी सम्पूर्ण पदाधिकारी तथा केन्द्रीय सदस्यहरूले पद तथा गोपनीयताको शपथ लिनेछन्। नवनिर्वाचित पार्टी सभापति गगनकुमार थापाले दसैँको फूलपातीका दिन असोज ३१ गते नै पद तथा गोपनीयताको शपथ ग्रहण गरिसकेकाले आज अरुले शपथ लिन लागेका हुन् । निर्वाचन समितिका सदस्य सचिव अधिवक्ता राजु कटुवालले शपथ ग्रहण कार्यक्रम विगतभन्दा फरक ढाँचामा सम्पन्न गरिने र नवनिर्वाचित नेताहरूलाई प्रमाणपत्र वितरणसँगै आजै पदबहालीसमेत गराइने जानकारी दिएका छन् । असोज १८ गतेदेखि २३ गतेसम्म काठमाडौँमा सम्पन्न १५औँ महाधिवेशनअन्तर्गत भएको निर्वाचनको अन्तिम नतिजा असोज ३० गते औपचारिक रूपमा सार्वजनिक गरिएको थियो। महाधिवेशन अन्तर्गत उदघाटन र बन्दसत्र खुल्ला मञ्चमा भएको थियो भने मतदान खुला मञ्च र राष्ट्रिय सभागृहमा भएको थियो । महाधिवेशनको मतदान असोज २३ गते भएको थियो भने त्यहीदिन राति सभापतिको मतगणना राष्ट्रिय सभागृहमा गरिएको थियो । सभापतिको मतगणनाको परिणाम २४ गते बिहानै आएको थियो । अन्य पदको मतगणना भने २४ गते रातिदेखि पार्टी केन्द्रीय कार्यालय बीपीनगर, सानेपामा गरिएको थियो । १४ औँ महाधिवेशनमा चार हजार ७०० मतदाताको मतगणना गर्न १२ दिन लागेकोमा यस पटक सात हजार ३ सय ९२ मतदाताको मतगणना एक हप्तामा सकिएको सदस्य सचिव कटुवालले जानकारी दिए । यसपटक झण्डै एक लाख ६२ हजार मतपत्र गणना गर्नु परेको उनले बताए । कूल २ सय २९ पदका लागि निर्वाचन भएकोमा ७७ प्रकारका पद रहेका थिए भने हरेकले २३ मतपत्रमा मतदान गर्नुपर्ने व्यवस्था थियो । महाधिवेशनबाट सभापतिमा गगन थापा सर्वाधिक ९४ प्रतिशत मतसहित निर्वाचित भएका थिए भने वरिष्ठ उपसभापतिमा विश्वप्रकाश शर्मा, खुला उपसभापतिमा डा. चन्द्रकान्त भण्डारी र ई. मधु आचार्य, महिला उपसभापतिमा पुष्पा भुसाल र समावेशी उपसभापतिमा विनोद चौधरी निर्वाचित भएका थिए । त्यस्तै महामन्त्रीत्रयमा प्रदीप पौडेल, उदयशमशेर जबरा र डा. डिला संग्रौला (पन्त) सहित समावेशी र प्राज्ञिक चरित्रको बलियो कार्यसमिति चयन भएको छ। शपथ ग्रहण र पदबहाली सम्पन्न भएसँगै नयाँ केन्द्रीय कार्यसमितिको पहिलो बैठक पनि आजै सानेपामा बस्ने तयारी छ। पहिलो बैठकले ऐतिहासिक महाधिवेशन सम्पन्न गराउन सहयोग गर्ने सम्पूर्ण महाधिवेशन प्रतिनिधि, निर्वाचन समिति, सुरक्षाकर्मी, सञ्चारकर्मी तथा पार्टी पंक्तिलाई धन्यवाद ज्ञापनलगायतका विषयमा निर्णय गर्ने जनाइएको छ। बैठकमा पार्टीको जिल्ला तथा प्रदेश अधिवेशनहरुका बारेमा पनि छलफल हुने नेताहरुले जानकारी दिएका छन् । Kathmandu. The new Central Working Committee elected by the 15th General Convention of the Nepali Congress will formally assume all responsibilities for running the party from today. The newly elected office bearers and members are about to take oath and assume their responsibilities at a special ceremony to be held at the central office (BP Smriti Bhawan) in Sanepa, Lalitpur at 2 pm today. According to the Central Election Committee, all the office bearers and central members, except the party president, will take the oath of office and secrecy at today's ceremony. The newly elected party president Gagan Kumar Thapa had already taken the oath of office and secrecy on the day of Dashain's flower festival on Asoj 16, so the others are going to take the oath today. Election Committee Member Secretary Advocate Raju Katuwal has informed that the swearing-in ceremony will be held in a different format than in the past and that the newly elected leaders will be inaugurated today along with the distribution of certificates. The final results of the elections held under the 15th General Convention held in Kathmandu from 18 to 23 Asoj were officially made public on 30 Asoj. The opening and closing sessions of the General Convention were held in the open forum, while voting took place in the open forum and the National Assembly. The voting for the general convention was held on Asoj 23, and the counting of votes for the president was done that night at the National Assembly. The results of the counting of votes for the president were announced on the morning of the 24th. The counting of votes for other posts was conducted at the party central office, BP Nagar, Sanepa, from the night of the 24th. While it took 12 days to count the votes of 4,700 voters in the 14th General Convention, this time the counting of votes of 7,392 voters was completed in a week, informed Member Secretary Katuwal. He said that this time, about 162,000 ballot papers had to be counted. Out of the 229 posts, there were 77 types of posts, and each person had to vote on 23 ballot papers. Gagan Thapa was elected as the president with the highest 94 percent votes from the general convention, while Bishwaprakash Sharma was elected as the senior vice president, Dr. Chandrakant Bhandari and E. Madhu Acharya as the open vice president, Pushpa Bhusal as the women's vice president, and Binod Chaudhary as the inclusive vice president. Similarly, a strong working committee of inclusive and academic character including Pradeep Poudel, Udaya Shamsher Jabra and Dr. Dila Sangraula (Pant) was elected as the general secretaries. With the swearing-in and inauguration, the first meeting of the new central working committee is also set to be held in Sanepa today. It is said that the first meeting will decide on issues such as a vote of thanks to all the general convention delegates, election committee, security personnel, media personnel and party ranks who helped in holding the historic general convention. The leaders have informed that the meeting will also discuss the party's district and provincial conventions.

त्यहीदिन राति सभापतिको मतगणना राष्ट्रिय सभागृहमा गरिएको थियो । सभापतिको मतगणनाको परिणाम २४ गते बिहानै आएको थियो । अन्य पदको मतगणना भने २४ गते रातिदेखि पार्टी केन्द्रीय कार्यालय बीपीनगर, सानेपामा गरिएको थियो । १४ औँ महाधिवेशनमा चार हजार ७०० मतदाताको मतगणना गर्न १२ दिन लागेकोमा यस पटक सात हजार ३ सय ९२ मतदाताको मतगणना एक हप्तामा सकिएको सदस्य सचिव कटुवालले जानकारी दिए । यसपटक झण्डै एक लाख ६२ हजार मतपत्र गणना गर्नु परेको उनले बताए । कूल २ सय २९ पदका लागि निर्वाचन भएकोमा ७७ प्रकारका पद रहेका थिए भने हरेकले २३ मतपत्रमा मतदान गर्नुपर्ने व्यवस्था थियो । महाधिवेशनबाट सभापतिमा गगन थापा सर्वाधिक ९४ प्रतिशत मतसहित निर्वाचित भएका थिए भने वरिष्ठ उपसभापतिमा विश्वप्रकाश शर्मा, खुला उपसभापतिमा डा. चन्द्रकान्त भण्डारी र ई. मधु आचार्य, महिला उपसभापतिमा पुष्पा भुसाल र समावेशी उपसभापतिमा विनोद चौधरी निर्वाचित भएका थिए । त्यस्तै महामन्त्रीत्रयमा प्रदीप पौडेल, उदयशमशेर जबरा र डा. डिला संग्रौला (पन्त) सहित समावेशी र प्राज्ञिक चरित्रको बलियो कार्यसमिति चयन भएको छ। शपथ ग्रहण र पदबहाली सम्पन्न भएसँगै नयाँ केन्द्रीय कार्यसमितिको पहिलो बैठक पनि आजै सानेपामा बस्ने तयारी छ। पहिलो बैठकले ऐतिहासिक महाधिवेशन सम्पन्न गराउन सहयोग गर्ने सम्पूर्ण महाधिवेशन प्रतिनिधि, निर्वाचन समिति, सुरक्षाकर्मी, सञ्चारकर्मी तथा पार्टी पंक्तिलाई धन्यवाद ज्ञापनलगायतका विषयमा निर्णय गर्ने जनाइएको छ। बैठकमा पार्टीको जिल्ला तथा प्रदेश अधिवेशनहरुका बारेमा पनि छलफल हुने नेताहरुले जानकारी दिएका छन् । Kathmandu. The new Central Working Committee elected by the 15th General Convention of the Nepali Congress will formally assume all responsibilities for running the party from today. The newly elected office bearers and members are about to take oath and assume their responsibilities at a special ceremony to be held at the central office (BP Smriti Bhawan) in Sanepa, Lalitpur at 2 pm today. According to the Central Election Committee, all the office bearers and central members, except the party president, will take the oath of office and secrecy at today's ceremony. The newly elected party president Gagan Kumar Thapa had already taken the oath of office and secrecy on the day of Dashain's flower festival on Asoj 16, so the others are going to take the oath today. Election Committee Member Secretary Advocate Raju Katuwal has informed that the swearing-in ceremony will be held in a different format than in the past and that the newly elected leaders will be inaugurated today along with the distribution of certificates. The final results of the elections held under the 15th General Convention held in Kathmandu from 18 to 23 Asoj were officially made public on 30 Asoj. The opening and closing sessions of the General Convention were held in the open forum, while voting took place in the open forum and the National Assembly. The voting for the general convention was held on Asoj 23, and the counting of votes for the president was done that night at the National Assembly. The results of the counting of votes for the president were announced on the morning of the 24th. The counting of votes for other posts was conducted at the party central office, BP Nagar, Sanepa, from the night of the 24th. While it took 12 days to count the votes of 4,700 voters in the 14th General Convention, this time the counting of votes of 7,392 voters was completed in a week, informed Member Secretary Katuwal. He said that this time, about 162,000 ballot papers had to be counted. Out of the 229 posts, there were 77 types of posts, and each person had to vote on 23 ballot papers. Gagan Thapa was elected as the president with the highest 94 percent votes from the general convention, while Bishwaprakash Sharma was elected as the senior vice president, Dr. Chandrakant Bhandari and E. Madhu Acharya as the open vice president, Pushpa Bhusal as the women's vice president, and Binod Chaudhary as the inclusive vice president. Similarly, a strong working committee of inclusive and academic character including Pradeep Poudel, Udaya Shamsher Jabra and Dr. Dila Sangraula (Pant) was elected as the general secretaries. With the swearing-in and inauguration, the first meeting of the new central working committee is also set to be held in Sanepa today. It is said that the first meeting will decide on issues such as a vote of thanks to all the general convention delegates, election committee, security personnel, media personnel and party ranks who helped in holding the historic general convention. The leaders have informed that the meeting will also discuss the party's district and provincial conventions.

The new Central Working Committee elected by the 15th General Convention of the Nepali Congress will formally assume all responsibilities for running the party from today. The newly elected office bearers and members are about to take oath and assume their responsibilities at a special ceremony to be held at the central office (BP Smriti Bhawan) in Sanepa, Lalitpur at 2 pm today. According to the Central Election Committee, all the office bearers and central members, except the party president, will take the oath of office and secrecy at today's ceremony. The newly elected party president Gagan Kumar Thapa had already taken the oath of office and secrecy on the day of Dashain's flower festival on Asoj 16, so the others are going to take the oath today. Election Committee Member Secretary Advocate Raju Katuwal has informed that the swearing-in ceremony will be held in a different format than in the past and that the newly elected leaders will be inaugurated today along with the distribution of certificates. The final results of the elections held under the 15th General Convention held in Kathmandu from 18 to 23 Asoj were officially made public on 30 Asoj. The opening and closing sessions of the General Convention were held in the open forum, while voting took place in the open forum and the National Assembly. The voting for the general convention was held on Asoj 23, and the counting of votes for the president was done that night at the National Assembly. The results of the counting of votes for the president were announced on the morning of the 24th. The counting of votes for other posts was conducted at the party central office, BP Nagar, Sanepa, from the night of the 24th. While it took 12 days to count the votes of 4,700 voters in the 14th General Convention, this time the counting of votes of 7,392 voters was completed in a week, informed Member Secretary Katuwal. He said that this time, about 162,000 ballot papers had to be counted. Out of the 229 posts, there were 77 types of posts, and each person had to vote on 23 ballot papers. Gagan Thapa was elected as the president with the highest 94 percent votes from the general convention, while Bishwaprakash Sharma was elected as the senior vice president, Dr. Chandrakant Bhandari and E. Madhu Acharya as the open vice president, Pushpa Bhusal as the women's vice president, and Binod Chaudhary as the inclusive vice president. Similarly, a strong working committee of inclusive and academic character including Pradeep Poudel, Udaya Shamsher Jabra and Dr. Dila Sangraula (Pant) was elected as the general secretaries. With the swearing-in and inauguration, the first meeting of the new central working committee is also set to be held in Sanepa today. It is said that the first meeting will decide on issues such as a vote of thanks to all the general convention delegates, election committee, security personnel, media personnel and party ranks who helped in holding the historic general convention. The leaders have informed that the meeting will also discuss the party's district and provincial conventions.

काठमाडौँ । नेपाली कांग्रेसको १५औँ महाधिवेशनबाट निर्वाचित नयाँ केन्द्रीय कार्यसमितिले आजदेखि विधिवत् रूपमा पार्टी सञ्चालनको सम्पूर्ण जिम्मेवारी सम्हाल्ने भएको छ । ललितपुरको सानेपास्थित केन्द्रीय कार्यालय (बीपी स्मृति भवन)मा आज दिउँसो २ बजे आयोजना हुने विशेष समारोहमा नवनिर्वाचित पदाधिकारी तथा सदस्यहरूले शपथ ग्रहण गरेर जिम्मेवारी सम्हाल्न लागेका हुन् । केन्द्रीय निर्वाचन समितिका अनुसार आजको समारोहमा पार्टी सभापतिबाहेक बाँकी सम्पूर्ण पदाधिकारी तथा केन्द्रीय सदस्यहरूले पद तथा गोपनीयताको शपथ लिनेछन्। नवनिर्वाचित पार्टी सभापति गगनकुमार थापाले दसैँको फूलपातीका दिन असोज ३१ गते नै पद तथा गोपनीयताको शपथ ग्रहण गरिसकेकाले आज अरुले शपथ लिन लागेका हुन् । निर्वाचन समितिका सदस्य सचिव अधिवक्ता राजु कटुवालले शपथ ग्रहण कार्यक्रम विगतभन्दा फरक ढाँचामा सम्पन्न गरिने र नवनिर्वाचित नेताहरूलाई प्रमाणपत्र वितरणसँगै आजै पदबहालीसमेत गराइने जानकारी दिएका छन् । असोज १८ गतेदेखि २३ गतेसम्म काठमाडौँमा सम्पन्न १५औँ महाधिवेशनअन्तर्गत भएको निर्वाचनको अन्तिम नतिजा असोज ३० गते औपचारिक रूपमा सार्वजनिक हजार ७०० मतदाताको मतगणना गर्न १२ दिन लागेकोमा यस पटक सात हजार ३ सय ९२ मतदाताको मतगणना एक हप्तामा सकिएको सदस्य सचिव कटुवालले जानकारी दिए । यसपटक झण्डै एक लाख ६२ हजार मतपत्र गणना गर्नु परेको उनले बताए । कूल २ सय २९ पदका लागि निर्वाचन भएकोमा ७७ प्रकारका पद रहेका थिए भने हरेकले २३ मतपत्रमा मतदान गर्नुपर्ने व्यवस्था थियो । महाधिवेशनबाट सभापतिमा गगन थापा सर्वाधिक ९४ प्रतिशत मतसहित निर्वाचित भएका थिए भने वरिष्ठ उपसभापतिमा विश्वप्रकाश शर्मा, खुला उपसभापतिमा डा. चन्द्रकान्त भण्डारी र ई. मधु आचार्य, महिला उपसभापतिमा पुष्पा भुसाल र समावेशी उपसभापतिमा विनोद चौधरी निर्वाचित भएका थिए । त्यस्तै महामन्त्रीत्रयमा प्रदीप पौडेल, उदयशमशेर जबरा र डा. डिला संग्रौला (पन्त) सहित समावेशी र प्राज्ञिक चरित्रको बलियो कार्यसमिति चयन भएको छ। शपथ ग्रहण र पदबहाली सम्पन्न भएसँगै नयाँ केन्द्रीय कार्यसमितिको पहिलो बैठक पनि आजै सानेपामा बस्ने तयारी छ। पहिलो बैठकले ऐतिहासिक महाधिवेशन सम्पन्न गराउन सहयोग गर्ने सम्पूर्ण महाधिवेशन प्रतिनिधि, निर्वाचन समिति, सुरक्षाकर्मी, सञ्चारकर्मी तथा पार्टी पंक्तिलाई The opening and closing sessions of the General Convention were held in the open forum, while voting took place in the open forum and the National Assembly.

The voting for the general convention was held on Asoj 23, and the counting of votes for the president was done that night at the National Assembly. The results of the counting of votes for the president were announced on the morning of the 24th.

The counting of votes for other posts was conducted at the party central office, BP Nagar, Sanepa, from the night of the 24th. While it took 12 days to count the votes of 4,700 voters in the 14th General Convention, this time the counting of votes of 7,392 voters was completed in a week, informed Member Secretary Katuwal.

He said that this time, about 162,000 ballot papers had to be counted. Out of the 229 posts, there were 77 types of posts, and each person had to vote on 23 ballot papers. Gagan Thapa was elected as the president with the highest 94 percent votes from the general convention, while Bishwaprakash Sharma was elected as the senior vice president, Dr. Chandrakant Bhandari and E. Madhu Acharya as the open vice president, Pushpa Bhusal as the women's vice president, and Binod Chaudhary as the inclusive vice president. Similarly, a strong working committee of inclusive and academic character including Pradeep Poudel, Udaya Shamsher Jabra and Dr. Dila Sangraula (Pant) was elected as the general secretaries.

With the swearing-in and inauguration, the first meeting of the new central working committee is also set to be held in Sanepa today. It is said that the first meeting will decide on issues such as a vote of thanks to all the general convention delegates, election committee, security personnel, media personnel and party ranks who helped in holding the historic general convention. The leaders have informed that the meeting will also discuss the party's district and provincial conventions.
